- This suggests competition will be high at y and x
- My high priority at w might be strategically advantageous

- Rejections don't eliminate future opportunities
- I can maintain flexibility by ranking strategically
- Order matters, but doesn't preclude eventual matching

- I want to honor my true preference (z is most desired)
- But I also want to maximize matching probability
- Ranking that reflects both preference and strategic positioning is key
